problems.detail: registry 拒绝了当前凭据（npm error code E401）。未登录时发布 scoped 包会报 404 Not found，看起来像「包不存在」。
problems.fix: npm login        # 浏览器/终端交互登录，然后重跑 `pnpm run release:publish`

notes: workspace: protocol: 5 dep(s), publish goes through pnpm (rewritten)
limits: this is the pre-publish check, not the release: it says nothing about the bytes a registry would serve (that is `record_publish`)
a registry it could not reach is reported as a note, never as a pass
